title: Ridgeline Installation Services Home-Signing Rescission Right
content:
An installation agreement of Ridgeline Installation Services signed in the customer's home, with a contract price at or above the program's rescission threshold, may be cancelled by the customer without any cancellation fee during the rescission period. Where the program's rescission right does not extend to the store or online, agreements signed in the store or online carry no rescission right and follow the cancellation fee terms.

## Rescission period

A rescission is accepted only when the customer cancels within the program's rescission days, counted in business days, after the agreement was signed. Business days are every calendar day except Sundays and federal holidays; the period runs through midnight at the end of the business day whose count, after the contract signing date, equals the program's rescission days, the signing date itself not counted. The signing date and the signing channel are read from the contract record.

## Boundary dates (3 business days; hypothetical dates on which no federal holiday falls)

| Signed on | Business day 1 | Business day 2 | Business day 3 (period ends at midnight) | Cancelling on | Accepted |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Friday | Saturday | Monday | Tuesday | Tuesday | yes |
| Friday | Saturday | Monday | Tuesday | Wednesday | no |
| Saturday | Monday | Tuesday | Wednesday | Wednesday | yes |

A federal holiday inside the period is not counted as a business day, in the same way as a Sunday, so the period then ends on a later calendar day.

## Effect of a rescission

- The contract is cancelled with the reason "rescinded".
- Every contract payment, the deposit and any progress payment, is refunded in full to its original tender with the refund reason "rescission".
- Any measure fee credit on the contract is void; the measure fee itself was a separate purchase and is not refunded.

## Confirmation

A rescission takes effect only on the customer's own confirmation.

| Signing channel | Contract price | Within the period | Customer confirms | Outcome |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| in the home | at or above the threshold | yes | yes | rescinded without a cancellation fee |
| in the home | at or above the threshold | no | yes | not a rescission |
| in the store or online | any | any | yes | no rescission right; cancellation fee terms apply |
